about: Terminology rules of pages/vocabulary.qmd, checked by verification/scan_vocabulary.mjs (Step 11.2) on page prose, widget strings, catalog entries and embed captions. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions (case-insensitive unless noted).

forbidden.why: no significance language: the site reports posterior summaries and prior statements
K* is the generating number of components; clusters are the components that units occupy, so K_J can be smaller

scoped.why: K_N is Broderick's notation for N customers; the site's count is K_J (Part 1 introduces the alias)
the site's population weight is w_k; rho_k is Broderick's name, used only where Part 1 introduces it (rho alone is the co-clustering probability)

misuse.why: W_SB is the size-biased first weight, not the largest weight (W_max)
K_J counts occupied clusters (fitted components), not all components
